title: The Spider: from core to add-on
description: How the ZAP Spider (crawler) is recorded in the zaproxy and zap-extensions histories: code in core since 2012, the Ajax Spider as an add-on, and the 2022 migration of the Spider into the spider add-on.

chapters.title: Spider code in core, 2010 to 2012
chapters.text: The commit "Version 1.0.0" (2010-09-04) adds files under src/org/parosproxy/paros/core/spider. On 2012-05-29 the commit "New SpiderParam in org.zaproxy.zap.spider. Modified extensions to accommodate with change." adds src/org/zaproxy/zap/spider/Spider.java and SpiderParam.java, and the commit "Switched to new Spider. ParosProxy implementations not used anymore." is dated the same day. On 2012-07-12 the commit "Removed old and unused Spider-related Paros Proxy packages." follows.

chapters.title: The Ajax Spider appears in zap-extensions
chapters.text: In zap-extensions, the commit "merged spiderAjax branch into trunk" is dated 2012-08-07 and adds lib/crawljax-2.1-SNAPSHOT.jar among other files. In zaproxy, the commit "Issue 1098 - Move AJAX Spider help pages to "Ajax Spider" add-on (and update them)" is dated 2014-03-23. In zap-extensions, "Issue 1326 - Move Ajax Spider Extension from Beta to Release status" is dated 2015-01-03.

chapters.title: January 2017: Spider functionality moved within core
chapters.text: On 2017-01-02 the commit "Deprecate unused Spider menu items" is dated; on 2017-01-04 the commit "Move Spider functionality to Spider extension" is dated. Both are in zaproxy and the Spider code is still in core at that point.

chapters.title: Ajax Spider gets its own project, 2019
chapters.text: On 2019-04-03 zap-extensions has the commit "spiderAjax: relocate to its own project". Before that date the extension code was under src/org/zaproxy/zap/extension/spiderAjax.

chapters.title: 2022: the spider add-on and the core deprecation
chapters.text: In zap-extensions, "feat: spider: Add spider add-on with SVG href parsing" is dated 2022-01-20 and "feat: Spider Migration" is dated 2022-04-27; the latter's message says the migration of the spider from core to zap-extensions is based on an earlier zaproxy commit. About a minute later, also on 2022-04-27, zaproxy has "chore: Spider Deprecation", whose diff adds @Deprecated annotations (47 added lines match). The add-on commit "spider: Promote to Release status" is dated 2022-06-27, and zaproxy's "Include spider add-on in weeklies" is dated 2022-08-22.

chapters.title: 2026: the deprecated core Spider is removed
chapters.text: On 2026-01-23 zaproxy has the commit "Remove deprecated spider" (68 files changed, 22085 lines deleted). At HEAD the directory zap/src/main/java/org/zaproxy/zap/spider does not exist in zaproxy, while addOns/spider and addOns/spiderAjax both exist in zap-extensions; the spider add-on's changelog lists version 0.20.0 dated 2026-04-02.
